definition: A Bearer Token is a security credential sent in the HTTP Authorization header (e.g. Authorization: Bearer <token>) granting access to protected API resources.
detailedExplanation: Whoever holds the bearer token is granted access. Tokens are typically JSON Web Tokens (JWT) or opaque string tokens issued via OAuth 2.0 or API key gateways.
commonMistakes: Passing bearer tokens in query parameters where logs index them
relatedToolTitle: Test Bearer Tokens in APIForge Workbench
